text.en:
The name of the Eastern Pangasinan/Asingan School of Arts and Trades in the Municipality of
Asingan, Province of Pangasinan, is hereby changed to Luciano Millan Memorial School of Arts and Trades.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: April 13, 1984
